Abstract
We address the problem of unreliable sensor calibration in small robots.

We propose a novel calibration algorithm using a sparse graph representation.

1 Introduction
Previous work by Example et al. [1] uses a dense calibration model.

Our contribution is an algorithm that optimizes a robust objective function.

Figure 1 illustrates the sparse graph architecture and calibration pipeline.
 2 Experiments
The experiment compares calibration accuracy against a dense baseline on a synthetic dataset.

Table 2 reports better accuracy under the stated noise conditions.

The main limitation is reduced accuracy when no calibration targets are visible.

We release an open-source implementation of the calibration algorithm.

3 Conclusion
The sparse graph mechanism is a candidate design for resource-limited robots.
